senate.description: Patient assistance program application of funds to a deductible disclosure requirement provision

Senate.text: Referred to Commerce and Consumer Protection

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to insurance; requiring disclosure of whether money from a patient assistance program is applied to a health plan deductible; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 62Q.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[62Q.671] DISCLOSURE OF APPLICATION OF FUNDS FROM A PATIENT ASSISTANCE PROGRAM TO A DEDUCTIBLE. +]

[+A health plan company must include in the summary of benefits and coverage a statement that indicates whether the health plan company applied money from a patient assistance program, as defined in section 62J.84, subdivision 2, paragraph (h), to an enrollee's deductible. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective January 1, 2026, and applies to health plans offered, issued, or renewed on or after that date. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to insurance; requiring disclosure of whether money from a patient assistance program is applied to a health plan deductible; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 62Q.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[62Q.671] DISCLOSURE OF APPLICATION OF FUNDS FROM A PATIENT ASSISTANCE PROGRAM TO A DEDUCTIBLE.

A health plan company must include in the summary of benefits and coverage a statement that indicates whether the health plan company applied money from a patient assistance program, as defined in section 62J.84, subdivision 2, paragraph (h), to an enrollee's deductible.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective January 1, 2026, and applies to health plans offered, issued, or renewed on or after that date.
